filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 3 Arabic videos. Coverage for English is excellent, with high-quality, highly relevant videos for all topics. Arabic coverage is weaker, with two topics left empty due to a lack of relevant, language-appropriate content. For two other Arabic topics, selections were made using the view-count exception rule, highlighting a scarcity of high-reach educational material in this domain.

videos.title: 3D Graphics: Crash Course Computer Science #27
videos.filter_reason: This CrashCourse video provides a high-quality, accessible overview of the computational challenges in 3D graphics, making it an excellent starting point.

videos.title: Code-It-Yourself! 3D Graphics Engine Part #1 - Triangles & Projection
videos.filter_reason: This video offers a foundational, practical guide to creating a 3D engine from scratch, perfectly explaining the core geometric concepts of vertices, triangles, and projection.

videos.title: How do Graphics Cards Work?  Exploring GPU Architecture
videos.filter_reason: This video provides a comprehensive and foundational explanation of GPU architecture, which is essential for understanding hardware limitations and memory constraints in graphics.
